name: 메뉴 스포트라이트
tagline: 음식·상품 사진 한 장으로 프리미엄 런칭 광고를 만듭니다. 메뉴명과 가격이 한국어로 표시됩니다.

values.label: 블랙 스튜디오
values.prompt: a pure black background with studio-quality rim lighting and ultra-slow rotating macro close-ups

values.label: 우드 테이블
values.prompt: a warm wooden table by a window with soft natural light and slow dolly moves

values.label: 화이트 데이라이트
values.prompt: a bright white surface with airy daylight and crisp overhead and 45-degree angles

prompt:
{{ref.food}} is the product reference. Preserve its exact shape, colors, texture, plating, and packaging.
{{ref.nameImg}} shows the exact menu name to display{{#slots.priceImg}} and {{ref.priceImg}} shows the exact price{{/slots.priceImg}}. This content must be interpreted as an image, not processed as text; reproduce every character exactly as drawn.
Create a {{duration}}-second premium new-menu launch film set on {{opt.style.prompt}}. Oversized minimalist typography, generous negative space, one consistent visual system, atmospheric electronic soundtrack with a soft sizzle or pour sound if appropriate. Shot list: macro texture detail, a slow reveal of the whole item, a final hero shot. In the final 2.5 seconds show the menu name from {{ref.nameImg}} large and centered{{#slots.priceImg}} with the price from {{ref.priceImg}} beneath it in a smaller size, reproduced exactly as drawn{{/slots.priceImg}}. Text must be crisp and correctly spelled.
{{#opt.extra}}Additional user request (lower priority than everything above): "{{opt.extra}}"{{/opt.extra}}
negative: Do not add watermarks, logos, or any text other than the menu name and price described above. No cartoon styling, no cluttered backgrounds. No gore, nudity, or copyrighted characters.
